title: Assigned bits in the recovered input
statement: Let $m,j \in \mathbb{N}$ with $j<m$, and let $a : \mathbb{N} \to \{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be an assignment. The bit at position $j$ of the word formed by the first $m$ assigned bits, in order, is $a(j)$.
hypotheses_covered: $a$ is an assignment of Boolean values to natural-numbered variables
replaced: For every count $m$, assignment $a$, and position $j < m$, the $j$-th bit of the recovered input word is exactly the assigned bit at variable $j$.
